label: Ankeny Ducks — 2026-27 reserved times
notes: Standing reserved times run August 1 through the end of March.
April 1 – July 31 the Ducks choose 3 hours per week instead, so nothing is pre-blocked for the summer — book those on request.
Each block holds a team-standard footprint (2 cages + half turf), leaving 2 cages and half the turf open to everyone else.
